Q01.evidence: Even though citizen scientists may not have science degrees ... they are still capable of making valuable contributions to science.
issues: 오답 ①②④⑤가 모두 본문과 정반대라 너무 쉬움
발췌가 STEVE 단락 끝에서 시작하는데 'these two projects'가 나옴. 두 번째 프로젝트(Galaxy Zoo)가 지문에 없어 지시 대상이 불명확함
Q09·Q16과 지문이 완전히 같음(교재 안에서 같은 지문이 세 번 나옴)

Q02.evidence: This might sound exciting, but his job there was dull and time-consuming. / It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies.
issues: ⑤는 지문 두 문장과 대놓고 반대여서 바로 골라짐(너무 쉬움)

Q03.evidence: the group members began to notice something strange appearing in the night sky ... They realized that the group had discovered a new type of phenomenon that had never been properly studied.
issues: 오답 ①③④⑤가 약해서 쉬움

Q04.evidence: In reality, science belongs to everyone, and we all have the ability to play a role in the advancement of science.
issues: 주장이 담긴 서론 뒤에 Schawinski 사례 첫 세 문장이 붙어 있지만, 풀이에는 지장 없음

Q05.evidence: If it had not been for those participants, Schawinski couldn't have classified that many images. / Galaxy Zoo has now grown into Zooniverse ...

Q06.evidence: There were unusual ribbons of green and purple light, some of which seemed to stretch for thousands of kilometers.
issues: 정답 ②가 본문 문장을 거의 그대로 옮겨서 낱말 일치만으로 풀림(너무 쉬움)
Q23과 지문이 같음

Q07.evidence: They confirmed that it was not an aurora, but it did not resemble anything they had seen before. / In order to learn more about it ...

Q08.evidence: 주어진 글 'this perception is far from the truth' → (B) In reality, science belongs to everyone ... two of them → (C) Kevin Schawinski ... classify around one million images → (A) Since they all looked similar ... 'do this'
issues: 같은 mock1의 Q10·Q11 장문 1단락과 내용이 겹침(Q11의 정답 낱말은 드러나지 않음)

Q09.evidence: Experts have acknowledged that ... the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group ... deserve the credit for discovering STEVE. [If it had not been for them, it might have remained unnoticed forever.] 앞 문장의 them(members)과 it(STEVE)을 받아 공로를 뒷받침함
issues: 'these two projects'의 지시 대상이 지문에 없음(Q01과 같음)
Q01과 지문이 같음

Q10.evidence: He had to classify around one million images ... Eventually, the two men ended up launching a crowdsourced online project ... The website was kept as simple as possible
issues: 오답 ①~④가 약해서 쉬움

Q11.evidence: ④ complicated는 바로 뒤 'with a very basic design and an easy-to-use interface'와 'get started quickly'에 어긋남. simple이 맞음

Q12.evidence: The website was kept as simple as possible ... more than 80,000 individuals participated ... If it had not been for those participants, Schawinski couldn't have classified that many images.

Q13.evidence: It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies. / one million images → 남은 950,000개를 혼자 하면 시간이 너무 오래 걸림, complained about the situation
issues: ④는 본문의 similar를 끌어온 오답인데, 뜻은 정답과 분명히 달라 문제 없음

Q14.evidence: Galaxy Zoo 참여자와 분류량 흐름 속에 망원경 관측 선호 문장이 끼어 있음. ③ 참여자 없이는 불가 → ⑤ In fact, 혼자면 수십 년

Q15.evidence: (A) something strange ... neither of them had any idea what Steve was → mysterious / (B) NASA funded a citizen science project involving the public ... asked ordinary people to gather photos → participation

issues: Q01·Q09와 지문이 같음
같은 mock2의 Q18 장문과 STEVE 단락이 겹침. 특히 Q16 지문의 'it might have remained unnoticed forever'가 Q18의 정답 ⑤ famous를 그대로 드러냄(같은 회차 안 정답 노출)

Q17.evidence: Experts have acknowledged that it is the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group that deserve the credit for discovering STEVE.

Q18.evidence: ⑤ famous: 'If it had not been for them, it might have remained famous forever'는 앞 문장(동호회원들이 발견의 공로를 받아야 한다)과 어긋남. unnoticed가 맞음
issues: 같은 mock2의 Q16 지문에 원래 문장 'remained unnoticed forever'가 그대로 나옴. 정답이 새어 나가므로 Q16 지문 범위를 바꾸거나 Q18 출제 낱말을 바꿔야 함

Q19.evidence: You can become one as well if you have curiosity and an interest in taking part in scientific research.
issues: 지문 첫 문장 'If it had not been for them, it might have remained unnoticed forever.'의 them과 it이 가리키는 말이 없어 글이 갑자기 시작됨. 'Experts have acknowledged ...'부터 시작하거나 첫 문장을 빼야 함
'these two projects'의 지시 대상이 지문에 없음
같은 mock3의 Q22 지문과 겹침

Q20.evidence: (C) Eventually ... launching ... Galaxy Zoo. The website was kept as simple as possible → (A) This allowed ... get started quickly ... brief tutorial → (B) Then they were shown an image ...

Q21.evidence: 주어진 문장이 75 million classifications 바로 뒤에 들어가야 ② 뒤 'In fact, it would have taken him decades on his own'의 him(Schawinski)이 가리키는 말이 생김
issues: Q05·Q14와 지문이 같음

Q22.evidence: There are many interesting theories about STEVE, but none of them have been proven for certain.
issues: ⑤가 본문 문장과 대놓고 반대여서 쉬움

issues: Q06과 지문이 같음

오답 ①②④⑤가 본문과 정반대이거나 관련이 없어 너무 쉬움

Q25.evidence: ② much: 'They seem to have very much in common with ordinary people like us. However, this perception is far from the truth.' 과학이 과학자만의 영역이라는 인식과 어긋남. little이 맞음
